decision_gate.or: end of the shock and recovery observed

design_freeze.rule: J v1.1 must not be modified while its shadow evidence is collected

evidence.double_adaptation: 0% cycle (cutoff 2026-09-18 01:00): base 1,531 already reacted, x2.5 factor -> 3,827 vs actual 450-1,317 at 07111
evidence.g2_fails_shock: G2 effect -9.6 pp in regime_3; corr(factor, needed) ~ 0; 30% of rows at the 2.5 clip vs 0.2% in regime_2
evidence.g2_heterogeneous: G2 effect by station in regime_2 ranges from -2.8 pp (07111) to +38.5 pp (03000)
evidence.g2_useful_sustained: G2 adds +4.0 pp in regime_2 (corr(factor, needed) = 0.74), up to +38.5 pp at 03000 and +26 pp at 05100
evidence.keep_where_g_works: the drift analysis recommends 'keep current behavior' where G already absorbs a sustained shift (6 stations at 86.8-92.2% in regime_2) and a recent-profile refit only where it does not
evidence.min_regime_length: the drift analysis segments the global series with a 3 h minimum regime length; regime_3 has lasted >= 5 h
evidence.normal_keep_g: G reaches 83.3% (leaderboard formula) in regime_1 and 90.6-92.2% on the stations still stable in regime_2
evidence.per_station_null: the drift analysis compares every station with its own stable range (per-station null windows)
evidence.shock_is_global: regime_3 hits 12/12 stations; the analysis calls a change global when >= 75% of stations are affected
evidence.shock_short_lags: regime_3 naive accuracy: lag_15 76.6%, lag_30 59.9%, lag_60 32.1%, lag_96 29.4%, weekly 23.0% vs G 26.0% and base F 38.5%
evidence.v1_replay_diagnosis: post-hoc: in the J v1 replay the recent-profile path cost -4.9 pp at 07107 and -5.2 pp at 06000 in phase 1 (stations where G worked) while gaining +4.3 pp overall on its rows in phase 2
